items.title: How Netanyahu survived the political fallout from the October 7 attacks

Reports that Arab leaders warned him of the assault in advance have undercut his claims that Israel's security chiefs are to blame, but his political base appears to be holding.

items.title: Live: Israel marks three years since Hamas’s deadly October 7 attacks
items.summary: Israelis on Wednesday began commemorations for the victims of Hamas’s October 7, 2023 attacks, which killed 1,200 people and saw 251 hostages taken. This year – the third anniversary of the attacks – is the first time all the hostages or their remains are home. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

items.title: Israel marks third anniversary of October 7 attack as election looms
items.summary: Israel will mark the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on Wednesday with memorial events across the country, as heightened security surrounds the commemorations and voters prepare for an election in which the deadliest day in Israel’s history is expected to remain a central issue.

The delay leaves Haitians without a democratic process as authorities struggle to register voters and secure areas needed for the poll.
